items.headline: Mike Locksley vows to fix Maryland after 54-3 drubbing
items.description: Maryland coach Mike Locksley recognized the mounting questions about his job status after a 54-3 home loss to UCLA on Saturday but vowed that he "won't stop fighting or coaching" for his players.
